job:
DESIGN SYSTEMS DESIGNER

Great Leap is seeking a Design Systems Designer to lead and evolve our design system infrastructure. You'll own our Figma environment, documentation, and component governance while partnering closely with engineering teams to ensure seamless implementation across our product ecosystem.

You'll be responsible for maintaining system health, establishing contribution standards, and scaling our design language across multiple product surfaces. This role requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset.

Must-have:

• 4+ years proven ownership of design systems at scale across multiple squads or teams
• Expert proficiency with Figma components and variables
• Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive design system documentation
• Strong track record of collaboration with front-end engineering teams on component implementation

Nice-to-have:

• Experience implementing design tokens across multiple brands or design systems
• Familiarity with Storybook or similar documentation platforms
• Background establishing governance frameworks and contribution models
• Experience with accessibility standards in design systems
